fusions.name: Clean Syllable
fusions.desc: Speaks a word of force that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Binding Recital
fusions.desc: Speaks a ring of force that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores resistances. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Practised Cadence
fusions.desc: Slips you 2 tiles from where you stood, then increases your cast speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Cast on the Run
fusions.desc: Every few tiles you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
